items.summary: Jones's questionnaire says he would push for stable funding, protect Free City, and base scheduling decisions on student demand.
items.title: Keep a large and diverse class catalog

citations.quote: First, I will work to keep a large and diverse class catalog.
My plan is to push for stable funding, protect Free City, and make sure scheduling decisions are based on student demand rather than cuts or short-term enrollment swings.

items.summary: Jones's questionnaire says he would work with the city, Muni and partners to improve transit access and expand discounted or free transit options.
items.title: Expand transit options for students

citations.quote: I will work with the city, Muni, and community partners to improve transit access, expand discounted or free transit options, and ensure classes are offered at times that match transit realities.

items.summary: Jones's questionnaire says he would push for long-term planning that centers community use of campuses and expands partnerships.
items.title: Maximize the use of City College campuses

citations.quote: Third, I will focus on maximizing the use of our campuses.

items.summary: The Guardsman reported that Jones said the college should pursue student and educator housing if it is an option, or partnerships with developers.
items.title: Pursue student and educator housing

citations.quote: “If providing student housing and educator housing is an option, we need to pursue that option,” Jones said.
